task: Resolved: automatic recovery audits disabled; affected-only banker relog
resume_instruction: Published no-automatic-audit policy. One startup scan per banker/host enforced by flushed marker and current gate run. Normal/paired/withdrawal/storage/reconnect scan workers and IPC triggers disabled with source retained; no roster recovery requests or global readiness block from their files. Banker fault queues one local relog outside trades with zero intentional reconnect delay; Manager untouched. Idle matching fresh bank/inventory resumes; unresolved operations/failures report and hold affected banker only, never authorize audit. Explicit console-admin bankers-bagaudit retained. Owner rebuild/restart; no assistant compilation/live test. Do not reintroduce auto audits.
